node_31.description: checking the café’s opening readiness by testing the espresso machine and confirming the seating

node_31.embedding_key: checking the café’s opening readiness by testing the espresso machine and confirming the seating
filling: Good morning, Bernard. Are we all set to open the cafe?
Good morning, Dolores. We’re nearly set. Please check the opening checklist and make sure the espresso machine and front seating are ready before we unlock the doors.
Of course. I’ll check the espresso machine and front seating against the checklist now, and let you know when everything’s ready.
Good. Check both carefully, and tell me immediately if anything is out of order. We open at eight; I don’t want surprises.
Understood. I’ll check the machine and seating carefully against the checklist, and I’ll tell you right away if I find anything wrong.
Good. I’ll finish the remaining opening preparations. Report back as soon as you’ve checked both items—don’t unlock the doors until we’re certain everything is ready.
The front seating is ready. I’m checking the espresso machine now, and I’ll let you know immediately if I find anything out of order.
All right. Test the machine through a full cycle, and check that it’s heating and pulling properly. Let me know as soon as you’ve finished.
Yes, Bernard. I’ll run a full cycle now and check the heating and extraction, then report back before we unlock the doors.
Good. I’ll keep the doors locked until you’ve completed the cycle and confirmed the machine is working properly. Report the results as soon as you’re done.
I’ve completed the full cycle. The machine is heating properly and pulling as it should. The front seating is ready as well, so we’re clear to open.
